name: Handle an HR case
intent: HR is where headless interfaces get companies fired. This skill is restricted, structured-input only, and never returns fields the agent cannot see in the HR Agent Workspace.

case_number.description: HR case number, e.g. HRC0010001. Alternatively supply subject_person + category.

category.description: HR service category; used with subject_person when no case number is supplied.

subject_person.description: Name of the employee the case is about; used with category when no case number is supplied.

procedure: Require sn_hr_core.case_writer or customer equivalent. Refuse discover-driven raw table access to HR tables from now/headless for users without the role.
No encoded queries from the model. Inputs are case number or subject person + category via picker.
Default return: number, state, topic, assigned to — not the case body — until the user asks to open the body.
Writes go through HR Flows only (LE activity, case comment). No generic Table PATCH.
sideEffects: HR Flow actions only (Lifecycle Event activity, case comment); no generic Table PATCH.

prompts: Show me HR case HRC0010001: state, topic, and who it is assigned to.
Find the open HR case about John Miller under Benefits.
Any HR cases about pay disputes assigned to me today?
